name: Hedera
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs explorer label and description.
rootCause: Hedera Network was exploited with $5.25M in stolen funds bridged from Hedera Mainnet to Ethereum. Attacker holds 2.36K ETH ($4.25M) and 15.58 WBTC ($1M). Initial funding from TornadoCash (1 ETH). Source: https://twitter.com/PeckShieldAlert/status/2075867053408629179
